items.question: Acḥal n wakud i yessefk i wakken ad bduɣ deg Podacium?
items.answer: Tzemreḍ ad tesnulfuḍ amiḍan sakin ad tebduḍ asnirem deg ddaw n snat n tesdidin. Anekcum amezwaru d baṭel yerna yeččur d tiɣuriwin n tazwara, asnirem n yisenfaren, d tmuɣliwin n tsemrasin n BI. Anekcum ummid yesra kan afran n wahil iwulmen tiwuriwin-ik.

items.question: Anta tiwsatin n yimiḍanen i teddunt deg Podacium?
items.answer: Podacium teqbel kraḍt n tiwsatin n yimiḍanen: Anelmad (i uselmed d usnefli n tmussniwin), Akensi (i umuddu n yimeẓla d tifin n yisenfaren), d Tanezzut (i usebded n yikensiyen d useqdec n yifecka n BI). Tzemreḍ ad tbeddleḍ gar temlilin neɣ ad tent-tesdukkleḍ deg yiwen n umiḍan.

items.question: Amek temgarrad Podacium ɣef yizaɣaren nniḍen?
items.answer: Podacium temgarrad deg usedkel n uselmed, amahil n ukensi, d tnezzut tuzzigt deg yiwen n uzaɣar amellil. Mgal ifecka i yebḍan, Podacium tessuruf i tmussniwin n tɣuriwin ad snernint amagrad n ukensi, d tesledt n BI ad tɛiwen iɣtasen n tebburt — akk deg yiwet n tawennaḍt.

items.question: Yella uɛraḍ baṭel i timura tusligin?
items.answer: Ih. Iseqdacen imaynuten sɛan aɛraḍ n 14 n wussan baṭel s unekcum ummid ɣer timura meqqren deg kraḍt n tiɣula: tiɣuriwin mebla cceḍ, asebded n yisenfaren, d tesledt n BI pro. Ur tettwasuter ara tkarḍa n lbanka, yerna tzemreḍ ad tsfexteḍ melmi tebɣiḍ deg tallit n uɛraḍ.

items.question: Anta tarrayin n tallalt i yellan?
items.answer: Akk iseqdacen zemren ad awḍen ɣer tsemlit-nneɣ, tamkarḍit n tmusniwin, d yiswiren n tmetti. Ahilen usligen sɛan tallalt s yimayl d wamsawal srid. Imsafagen n tebbura meqqren sɛan tallalt tamezwarut s umḍebber uslig d wakud n tririt yettwaḍemnen.

items.question: Amek i tettḥadaw Podacium ɣef yisefka-inu d tbaḍnit?
items.answer: Podacium tesseqdac taɣellist tameqqrant gar-asent astenyed deg usekles d unqal, asenqed n lebda n tɣellist, d usefrek uqsiḥ n unekcum. Nqader ilugan n GDPR d uḥader n yisefka. Tebɣiḍ ad teṭṭfeḍ bab n yisefka-ik yerna tzemreḍ ad ten-tessufɣeḍ neɣ ad ten-temḥuḍ melmi tebɣiḍ.

items.question: Tettmuddu-d Podacium anekcum s API i usedkel d yifecka-inu yellan?
items.answer: Ih. Podacium temmud-d REST API i unekcum s tmusniwt ɣer tɣuriwin, isenfaren, tagrummiwin n yisefka, d usefrek n yiseqdacen. API-a yella deg wahilen n Tnezzut d Tebbut tameqqrant s talast d usentked s tsarut n API. Tasemlit tummidt n API s yixfawen, imedyaten, d yisuddimen n SDK tella deg teɣult n yisneflayen.

items.question: Zemreɣ ad unagɣ isefka-inu ma fernen ad ǧǧeɣ Podacium?
items.answer: Ih. Tzemreḍ ad tessufɣeḍ akk isefka-ik melmi tebɣiḍ — gar-asen asurif n tɣuriwin, iselkanen, amazray n yisenfaren, d tifelwiyin n BI — deg talɣiwin yettwaqeblen deg tebbura. Tufɣa n yisefka tella deg useddu n uzaɣar. Amḥay n umiḍan yekkes isefka-ik udmawanen deg 30 n wussan ilmend n yisuḍaf n GDPR.
